question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        lt.term_start,
        lt.term_end,
        year(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) AS start_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        state,
        term_end,
        start_year,
        CAST(start_year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS check_date_6,
        CAST(start_year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS check_date_8
    FROM first_terms
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        state,
        term_end,
        start_year,
        check_date_6,
        check_date_8,
        CASE WHEN term_end > check_date_6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_6,
        CASE WHEN term_end > check_date_8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_8
    FROM retention_check
)
SELECT gender, state, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(retained_6) AS retained_6, SUM(retained_8) AS retained_8, 1.0 * SUM(retained_6) / COUNT(*) AS pct_6, 1.0 * SUM(retained_8) / COUNT(*) AS pct_8
FROM retained
GROUP BY gender, state
HAVING pct_6 > 0
ORDER BY pct_6 DESC
LIMIT 20
